matches.rationale: The ground truth flags a flawed definition/expression of the operation ⊙_t that undermines subsequent results relying on it. Findings 4, 6, 7, 8, and 9 each trace concrete theorem failures (Thm 3.3, 3.5, 4.2, 4.3, 4.7) directly back to mishandling of the ⊙_t operation (e.g., ignoring that t acts as a zero/absorbing element, or substituting the wrong operation/formula), which are the detectable symptoms of this single definitional defect per R3.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Flags a distinct, plausible error in the elementary symmetric polynomial definition (Def 2.4), unrelated to the ⊙_t operation.
Targets the separate ⊙_{l,k} group claim in Definition 2.6, a different operation family from ⊙_t referenced in the ground truth.
Points to a genuine issue in Definition 2.3 about thick/syndetic sets, unrelated to the ⊙_t operation defect.
Shows Theorem 3.3 fails because t is a zero element of ⊙_t, a direct downstream consequence of the flawed operation.
Concerns the multiplicative semigroup (βZ,·), a different operation from ⊙_t and not part of the ground-truth defect.
Identifies Theorem 3.5's false claim stemming from t being a zero in ⊙_t, a symptom of the same operation defect.
Shows Theorem 4.2 fails due to the thick/absorbing behavior of t under ⊙_t, consistent with the flawed operation definition.
Details proof errors in Theorem 4.3 arising from misapplication/mis-derivation involving the ⊙_t operation.
Identifies that Theorem 4.7's proof incorrectly uses ⊙_t instead of ⊙_{-t}, another symptom tied to the ⊙_t operation's flawed treatment.
Concerns the ⊙_{l,k} family formula mismatch (Def 2.6), a separate operation from ⊙_t.
Flags an undefined ⊕_{l,k} notation in Corollary 4.14, unrelated to the ⊙_t operation defect.
